description: Goose Basket Shuffle is an original physics find-and-clear game with three complete themes. Pull objects into a 7-slot tray, match three, shake your phone to turn the basket, and clear twenty-four levels. Relaxed play is untimed by default, timed challenge is optional, and personal progress stays on this device.
description_zh: 鹅篮翻翻乐是一款原创物理找物三消小游戏，包含鲜集篮、农庄木箱和夜市灯笼三套完整主题。把物品捞进 7 格托盘，凑齐三个同款消除，还可甩动手机翻动篮子。默认无倒计时，限时挑战可选，个人进度保存在本机。
